item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v5.0.0
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **onboarding**: Add theme-aware 5.0 upgrade introduction - **library**: Add Mornye browsing and contextual compact navigation - **home**: Add large featured cards for extension feeds - **mornye**: Separate Search into a circular navigation button - **profile**: Add local profiles with backup and restore - **player**: Add beat-matched AutoMix and refine Mornye navigation - **artists**: Add branded headers and incremental release loading - **mornye**: Cache motion covers and refine player and search - **ui**: Add Mornye glass theme and adaptive music player - Add opt-in Discord Rich Presence on Android - **metadata**: Display saved ReplayGain values and refresh after analysis - **backend**: Migrate production backend to Rust - **backup**: Allow selecting categories and settings-only backups
### Bug Fixes
- **ci**: Audit stripped iOS archives and configure FFmpeg tests - Retry verification browser launch and failed searches - Sync lyric romanization and clear stale selection menus - **mornye**: Show track summary and update welcome branding - **metadata**: Remove nested barcode card background - **mornye**: Preserve icon meaning and use consistent settings accents - **settings**: Simplify player copy and add glass library info card - **ui**: Resolve album titles and show Home explicit badges - **ui**: Align local lyrics and refine Mornye selection - **player**: Preserve offline motion artwork and smooth cover changes - **ios**: Keep release feed bundle identity in sync - **android**: Validate native metadata editor results - Preserve source artist credits when downloading - **library**: Reset checkpoints and artwork on forced full scans - **metadata**: Read tags and covers from MP4 files named opus - **library**: Preserve cached covers across directory aliases - **download**: Log provider failures before fallback - **extensions**: Restore URL globals for provider link resolution - **download**: Preserve filenames after automatic SAF conversion - **backup**: Allow selecting SFLB archives for restore
### Performance
- **rust**: Stream discarded FLAC artwork during replacement - **extensions**: Avoid copying unwrapped Base64 input - **bridge**: Reduce metadata copies and decode large JSON off the UI isolate - **analysis**: Reuse sorted spectral percentile windows - **audio**: Share the Opus artwork metadata buffer - **search**: Release derived caches when track results change - **library**: Dispose unused playback row subscriptions - **metadata**: Move normalized Rust values into response envelopes - **rust**: Reduce peak allocations when resizing cover artwork - **mornye**: Reuse exact luminance contributions for contrast sampling - **mornye**: Release outgoing artwork decoders when replaced - **player**: Scope position and contrast rebuilds to controls - **extensions**: Collect unreachable JavaScript cycles after idle bursts - **images**: Decode local covers to their fitted display size - **extensions**: Share retained source text across manager and VMs - **extensions**: Reuse owned UTF-8 buffers at text boundaries - **metadata**: Preserve typed values across the Rust extension bridge - **extensions**: Validate JSON without allocating argument trees - **cue**: Parse SAF previews without copying audio - **android**: Batch SAF library recovery metadata queries - **library**: Batch album deletion and refresh once - **android**: Batch SAF lookups during download publication - **downloads**: Log finalization stage durations - **audio**: Validate FLAC remuxes before encoder fallback - **downloads**: Reuse lyrics supplied by the backend - **downloads**: Reuse HTTP connections between tracks - **lyrics**: Stream MP3 audio when updating ID3 lyrics - **analysis**: Serialize and cancel owned FFmpeg sessions - **backup**: Move archive processing off the UI isolate - **player**: Commit seek gestures once after scrubbing - **ui**: Pause motion headers when collapsed - **theme**: Bound cover palette decoding and coalesce requests - **rust**: Skip audio rewrites for identical FLAC metadata
### Refactoring
- **ui**: Unify theme styling and enlarge profile button
### Styling
- Remove trailing whitespace
### Dependencies
- **deps**: Update Flutter and iOS plugin dependencies
### Chores
- **rust**: Update crypto, network and UniFFI dependencies - **android**: Update native dependencies and build tooling - **analyzer**: Exclude archived internal sources - **release**: Set app version to 5.0.0+152 - Update AltStore source to v4.9.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.6...v5.0.0](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.6...v5.0.0)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm32.apk` (older devices)
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v4.9.6
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 4.9.6 | SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **about**: Show compiled short Git commit - **metadata**: Add safe batch editing and matching - **library**: Add bulk duplicate cleanup
### Bug Fixes
- **metadata**: Preserve track tags across collection screens - **replaygain**: Report decoder failures and reject incomplete scans - **memory**: Release retired runtimes and idle download heap - **download**: Resolve missing album folders before publishing - **metadata**: Read quality from Opus in MP4 containers - **download**: Remove legacy HIGH quality conversion - **download**: Preserve native containers before legacy quality conversion - **download**: Publish converted SAF files with the final extension - **download**: Size quality picker to its content - **download**: Allow dragging the quality picker to dismiss - **library**: Retain Opus badges when bitrate is missing - **download**: Estimate sizes from track quality metadata - **download**: Compare size estimates at each quality tier - **replaygain**: Write and verify native Opus gain tags - **metadata**: Match recording IDs across inconsistent catalogs - **metadata**: Normalize artist credits and preserve recording versions - **altstore**: Match source bundle ID to released IPA - **download**: Prepare fallback sessions before availability checks - **metadata**: Preserve Opus tags during batch re-enrichment - Restore SAF metadata fallback and preserve active transfers - **download**: Preserve verification provider during fallback - Resolve backend and test analyzer diagnostics - **download**: Route verification notifications to pending challenges - **extensions**: Preserve verification on availability errors - **extensions**: Bound stream resolution without timing out active transfers - **download**: Preserve audio quality across provider fallback - **lyrics**: Align usability checks with shared fixtures - **library**: Bound playlist picker SQL parameters - **playback**: Retain ReplayGain for SAF descriptor leases - **android**: Scope SAF read failures to each descriptor - **ios**: Isolate download progress subscriptions - **metadata**: Preserve Track fields during enrichment - **conversion**: Reserve FLAC outputs without overwriting files - **search**: Let latest live queries supersede cancelled requests - **auth**: Preserve shared signed-session challenge identity - **ui**: Resolve collapsed header title overlap - **ui**: Improve adaptive phone and tablet layouts - **cover**: Preserve provider high-resolution artwork - **extensions**: Shorten verification timeout - **audio**: Preserve Opus codec in M4A scans - **extensions**: Preserve verification callback retries - **conversion**: Preserve Unicode SAF document names
### Performance
- **ui**: Retain platform link lookup across rebuilds - **ui**: Retain track history lookup snapshots - **metadata**: Read complete SAF tags through descriptors - **mp3**: Share bounded ID3 metadata and cover reads - **library**: Page missing-file cleanup with safe SAF batch checks - **extensions**: Clone only the requested storage value - **artwork**: Batch and throttle cached preview validation - **library**: Reuse collection lookups across selection rebuilds - **search**: Decode large extension results off the UI isolate - **library**: Stream normalized scan timestamp snapshots - **cache**: Enforce cover byte budget during foreground use - **queue**: Apply sparse progress updates with chunked snapshots - **images**: Size decoded covers from layout constraints
### Refactoring
- **i18n**: Share supported language choices - **batch**: Share local track actions and phase settings - **ffmpeg**: Remove unused live DASH subsystem
### Documentation
- **changelog**: Document version 4.9.6
### Styling
- **dart**: Apply pinned formatter to existing files
### Testing
- Decouple app fixtures from extension identities
### Chores
- **release**: Bump app version to 4.9.6 - **ios**: Reuse backend build script without duplicate framework setup - Update AltStore source to v4.9.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
### Build
- **ios**: Require iOS 16 and restore local builds
### Revert
- Remove download size estimates
**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.5...v4.9.6](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.5...v4.9.6)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm32.apk` (older devices)
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
